name: west-mountain
_comment: West Coast + Mountain target: Portland OR, Seattle WA, Denver CO — strongest KEYLESS open data in-zone, NO paid/bot-blocked recorder wall (unlike Phoenix/Maricopa + Las Vegas/Clark, gated per the deed survey). Signal readiness (verified live 2026-07-28): SEATTLE fires in-box NOW — adapters/portland_code_violations.py defaults to Seattle SDCI code complaints (Socrata ez4a-iug7, keyless); a bounded --live run surfaced ~818 WA candidates. FEMA disasters fire nationally in-box (wildfire/flood). PORTLAND is a drop-in fixture until the free PortlandMaps API key (a login — David-gated, kanban t_fe8ddebb). DENVER is ArcGIS-not-Socrata and its code-violation endpoint is UNVERIFIED — needs a dedicated probe or swap for a confirmed-Socrata Mountain metro. The assumable/ACRIS + Philly/NYC tax adapters are East-only and do not contribute here (West recorders aren't keyless — deed survey rec #4).
